content.text: {"id":"05f26297-67a5-4d84-adbf-3ce6b515e028","audio_id":"4a149cf9-b54d-48f1-8b47-9db27b14d8af","status":"complete","created_at":"2026-11-16T04:58:47Z","answer":"The lead is a bright, light, high-register voice with a childlike, airy quality; it sounds tightly pitch-corrected, with light reverb and some doubled/unison emphasis on the hook. The verses move in short, bouncy melodic phrases, while repeated “통통통”/“빵빵” hook lines are more chant-like, but still rhythmically shaped rather than simply spoken repetition. A steady, buoyant 4/4 pop groove pairs a synth-bass pulse with crisp clap/snap-like accents and bright chordal backing. The hook is fuller and more emphatic than the comparatively conversational verse, though the arrangement remains consistent.\n\nThe Korean target words are generally clear. One brief “통통통” pickup around 17.6–17.9 and another around 68.2–68.6 sit very tightly against the following line; the later repeated “공아 통통 자동차 빵빵” passage around 51–64 is denser and more chant-like, but I do not hear a clear glitch or severe word chop. The transcript/alignment drops or truncates words in a few places—most notably later lines around 38.7–46.2 and the final line around 72.2–75.5—so those omissions alone are not evidence that the recording is unclear. The longest actual instrumental gap is the outro after the last vocal, roughly 75.5–86.0; the backing continues and fades/ends instrumentally. First vocal is about 1.35 s; last vocal is about 75.5 s. Measured tempo: 114 BPM in 4/4."}
